readout_other: Scalp EEG time-frequency analysis (band power, peak frequency); Nissl, Iba1, c-Fos and GAD65 staining
direction_notes: In the PTZ seizure model, LIFUS lowered delta and theta peak frequency and theta and beta band power relative to the untreated group, and histology showed less damage, lower c-Fos and higher GAD65 expression.

timing.protocol_description: Three 3 min sonications (tone-burst duration 0.5 ms, pulse repetition interval 10 ms) delivered every 10 min starting 5 min after PTZ injection in the treated group; the untreated group was not sonicated.

source_quotes.n_subjects: The experimental animals (n = 23) were randomly divided into two groups: the untreated (n = 7) and treated with LIFUS groups (n = 16).

flags.reason: 29 rats were stated; 25 used; 23 in the two PTZ groups (7 untreated, 16 LIFUS) plus 2 normal. Recorded the 16 sonicated animals.

Table 1 intensities are described as measured/estimated at the target brain area (NEMA method) with skull attenuation (46.5%) compensated; recorded as in_situ derating. Ispta given in mW/cm2 in the table, converted to W/cm2.
Given as a pulse repetition interval of 10 ms, converted to 100 Hz.
Target is named only in the Discussion ('hippocampus and anteroventral thalamus'); the Methods say 'desired target area'.
The untreated group underwent PTZ and EEG without LIFUS; the abstract calls it 'untreated (sham)'. No device-in-place sham is described.
Three 3 min sonications per animal; 180 s is the length of one train.
